title: The Superior Nature of Christ
english: If all created nature worships Christ—for through the designation of the angels he signifies a nature superior in reason, just as it was once said in some [passage] concerning the angels: 'Sit at my right hand' (Ps 110:1); and he is above this—and the word of the scriptures said to worship by means of creation, not looking up, saying, 'looking into heaven, and seeing the sun and the moon and the stars and all the cosmos of heaven, having wandered, you shall worship them' (Jer 51:41). Since worshiping these is forbidden, so also for the other creatures, even if any should happen to be highly ascended. As has been said before, it is fitting to be confirmed that it is not a creature but the Creator who is Christ, even if through us he united to himself the created flesh having obtained a soul rational and spiritual, and thus he is worshiped as God by all the creation (Heb 1:6).
To all belongs time, and an opportune time to every single thing under the heaven.
translator_notes: True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.

title: Christ's Union with the Created Flesh
english: Christ, even if through us he united to himself the created flesh, having been granted a soul both rational and spiritual, and thus being worshiped as God by all of creation.
Time for all things, and an opportune time for every single thing under the heaven (Ecclesiastes 3:1).
